violations.description: DD brake same-day circular: dd_pct computed from cumprod(1+raw_ret) includes current day return, then dd_exp applied to same day return (lines 100-102). No t-1 lag on dd_pct.
MRS overlay uses same-month FRED regime data (macro_regime_dt[YM==daily_ym[i]]) applied to all daily returns within that month. Old FRED MRS pattern flagged in L-441 as SR ~18% overestimation.
FRED_REGIME_CACHE data time-axis: monthly FRED data applied same-month via YM matching. FRED publishes month-end, applying to entire month = look-ahead within month.

gate1_statistical_defense.note: DSR=1.000, SR=1.429, N=465 trials. Harvey t-stat well above 3.0.

gate4_economic_logic.mechanism: Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift (PEAD) + OtherCorp net buying = institutional informed flow. Low idiovol provides stability. Academic basis: Ball & Brown (1968) for PEAD, Sias (2004) for institutional flow.
gate4_economic_logic.note: Sound economic rationale. SUE captures earnings surprise; OtherCorp captures institutional conviction.

gate5_diversity.note: No Grade A composite cache available for correlation check. Family oc_sue has 4 trials, 4 passes.

c_code_summary.C2: PASS - signal computed before next-month application
c_code_summary.C4: PASS - SUE data filtered up to sig_d with 7-day lookback
c_code_summary.C5: FAIL - MRS overlay same-month application (old pattern L-441)
c_code_summary.C9: FAIL - DD brake same-day circular (no t-1 lag)

verdict_reasoning: Grade A with strong fundamentals (SR 1.429, CAGR 17.6%, MDD 22.8%, OOS 69%). However, C9 (DD same-day) and C5/C11 (old MRS pattern) violations mean the overlay-enhanced metrics are unreliable. The BASE signal (IVOL + OtherCorp + SUE) is clean. Recommend: (1) apply t-1 lag to DD brake, (2) replace old MRS with Regime Engine v7.1 or remove MRS overlay entirely, (3) re-run to get clean metrics.
